translations.web: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.
translations.bsb: Jesus asked His disciples to have a boat ready for Him so that the crowd would not crush Him.
translations.kjv: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.
translations.asv: And he spake to his disciples, that a little boat should wait on him because of the crowd, lest they should throng him:
